explication: RxJava is a JVM reactive-programming library for composing asynchronous and event-based sequences. Users assemble a flow from a source and operators, subscribe a consumer, then receive items or terminal signals; Flowable adds backpressure, while Streamable provides blocking handoff and natural backpressure. The graph preserves the documented flow types, scheduling, parallel processing, replay, and plugin hooks. Relationships are limited to the README’s workflow statements and explicit source references; unsampled implementations are represented only where the tree supports their paths.
